rows_written_is_derived: through Gate 157 this was a declared 0, which was true only because the cycle could not write. It is now counted, so a cycle that writes cannot report that it did not - and cycle_invariant_failures checks it AGREES with the per-job results rather than simply dropping the old must-be-zero check.
why_the_default_did_not_change: nothing that called run_scheduler_cycle before Gate 158 writes a row now. Persisting is opt-in.
